AdjustmentIn.description:
`amount` is in USD units, in the displayed sign convention: an expense is positive, so
removing a one-off charge from SG&A is a negative amount.
AdjustmentIn.title: AdjustmentIn

BuiltCellOut.description: A parent cell the sum of a complete custom breakdown fills or changes.
BuiltCellOut.title: BuiltCellOut

CapitalRowOut.description:
`values` in USD (outflows negative), x or pct (fractions); `pct_of_cfo`/`pct_of_fcf` are
null for rows that are not shares of cash flow.
CapitalRowOut.title: CapitalRowOut

CellAdjustmentOut.description:
An adjustment behind a statement cell. `via` is the adjusted line when the cell got the
change through propagation (SG&A for the operating income it rolls into), else null.
CellAdjustmentOut.title: CellAdjustmentOut

CheckOut.description: The engine's 90% band for a year the user set, and whether the value lies outside it.
CheckOut.title: CheckOut

CompanyListItem.description: A company with its key stats (erd/workspace.md), each null when it cannot be computed.

revenue_growth.description: TTM revenue growth, as a fraction
revenue_growth.title: Revenue Growth

CompanyListItem.title: CompanyListItem

CompsRowOut.description:
`pct` values are fractions. `peers` is aligned with `CompsOut.companies[1:]`; `n` counts
the peer values the statistics use. `target_vs_median` is a ratio minus one for `x` and
`days` rows and a difference for `pct` rows; `target_rank` is 1 for the highest.
CompsRowOut.title: CompsRowOut

CompsSetIn.description: `members` are tickers of followed companies; a PUT replaces them all.
CompsSetIn.title: CompsSetIn

DriverChangeOut.description: A stored row a driver file changes: its kind and value before and after (null: none).
DriverChangeOut.title: DriverChangeOut

DriverEnginesOut.description:
The driver's whole consecutive run (`history`), the case's resolved values and sources per
forecast year, each Tier 2 engine fit on the run, the M4 mean and the seasonal index.
DriverEnginesOut.title: DriverEnginesOut

DriverFileErrorsOut.description: The 422 body of a driver file with errors.
DriverFileErrorsOut.title: DriverFileErrorsOut

DriverFileIssueOut.description: An error of a driver file; `row` and `column` (a letter) say where, null for the file.
DriverFileIssueOut.title: DriverFileIssueOut

DriverGridOut.description:
`history_years` / `forecast_years` are the annual years in both frequencies; the rows'
`history` is aligned with `history_periods` and `values` / `sources` / `own` with
`forecast_periods` (the years for `annual`, the actual and the span's quarters for
`quarterly`).
DriverGridOut.title: DriverGridOut

DriverImportOut.description:
A driver file's changes; `grid` is the new grid after a confirmed import, null for a dry
run.
DriverImportOut.title: DriverImportOut

DriverRowOut.description:
`history` is aligned with the grid's `history_years`; `values`, `sources` and `own` with
its `forecast_years`. A value held flat is null with source `default`; a required driver
nothing sets is null with source null. `own` is the case's stored value, or offset when
`kind` is `offset`.
DriverRowOut.title: DriverRowOut

DriversIn.description: Each row replaces the stored rows of its driver of its frequency in the case.
DriversIn.title: DriversIn

EngineChoicesIn.description:
Each row sets one driver's engine (`auto` deletes the choice); drivers not listed are
untouched.
EngineChoicesIn.title: EngineChoicesIn

EngineFitOut.description:
One engine's forecast on the whole run: the point and the 90% / 50% quantiles per forecast
year (empty with `error` set when it could not fit).
EngineFitOut.title: EngineFitOut

EngineRowOut.description:
`engine` is the choice (`auto` when none is stored), `used` what produced the default (null
for a driver with no numeric default), `seasonal` whether `stl` is allowed.
EngineRowOut.title: EngineRowOut

FillAnnualIn.description: `dry_run` counts what would change and writes nothing.
FillAnnualIn.title: FillAnnualIn

FlagRuleOut.description:
One rule's values and severities, aligned with `periods`; `warn`/`alert` are the effective
number levels and `warn_formula`/`alert_formula` the formula ones (as typed), with
`warn_levels`/`alert_levels` each level's value per period. A null value has a null
severity. `error` is set when a stored formula of the rule no longer parses.
FlagRuleOut.title: FlagRuleOut

ForecastOut.description: The statement payload with the actual periods then the forecast ones (`is_forecast`).
ForecastOut.title: ForecastOut

GridPeriodOut.description: A column of the grid: a fiscal year (`FY`) or a quarter (`Q1`..`Q4`) with its label.
GridPeriodOut.title: GridPeriodOut

GuidanceEntryOut.description:
`unit` is null for a KPI whose series was deleted (the entry stays, pending). `surprise` is
(actual - midpoint) / |midpoint|, not flipped for `lower`. `latest` is false for a revision.
GuidanceEntryOut.title: GuidanceEntryOut

GuidanceIn.description:
`low` and `high` are in the metric's units and the displayed sign convention of the
statements (capex guidance of 10-11 B is -11 B to -10 B); a point estimate has low = high.
`direction` defaults from the metric.
GuidanceIn.title: GuidanceIn

GuidanceSummaryOut.description:
Counts of the latest entries; `hit_rate` = (beat + in_range) / (beat + in_range + miss),
null when nothing is decided.
GuidanceSummaryOut.title: GuidanceSummaryOut

ImportFileErrorsOut.description: The 422 body of a file with errors.
ImportFileErrorsOut.title: ImportFileErrorsOut

ImportFileIssueOut.description: A warning or an error of the file; `sheet`, `row` and `column` (a letter) say where.
ImportFileIssueOut.title: ImportFileIssueOut

ImportIssueOut.description: One entry of the 422 body's `errors`; documented here for the OpenAPI client.
ImportIssueOut.title: ImportIssueOut

ImportPreviewOut.description:
What an import fills and leaves alone. `import_id` is null for a dry run and for a file
that fills no cell and changes no custom line.
ImportPreviewOut.title: ImportPreviewOut

IntegrityOut.description: One forecast period's checks (USD differences); `ok` when each is within 0.01 USD.
IntegrityOut.title: IntegrityOut

LineChangeOut.description: A custom line the import creates, under `parent`.
LineChangeOut.title: LineChangeOut

NoteIn.description:
The link is a subject (`canonical_code` for a line, or `metric_kind` + `metric_code` for a
ratio, capital or quality metric; not both) and/or `fiscal_year` + `fiscal_period` (a cell,
a subject, a period or none). A PUT replaces the whole note, so leaving the link out unlinks it;
`note_date` defaults to today (UTC) on a POST and keeps the stored date on a PUT.
NoteIn.title: NoteIn

NoteLinkOut.description: One distinct link and how many notes have it.
NoteLinkOut.title: NoteLinkOut

QoeCustomRuleOut.description:
A stored custom rule. A number level is in `warn` / `alert`, a formula level in
`warn_formula` / `alert_formula` (as typed); `error` is set when a stored formula no longer
parses.
QoeCustomRuleOut.title: QoeCustomRuleOut

QoeRuleOut.description:
A quality-of-earnings rule with its effective levels and the shipped defaults. Levels are
fractions for `pct` rules; a null level means the rule has none. A formula level is in
`warn_formula` / `alert_formula` (as typed), with `warn` / `alert` null. A custom rule has
`custom`, its `formula` (also in `rule`) and null defaults; `error` is set when a stored
formula no longer parses.
QoeRuleOut.title: QoeRuleOut

QoeThresholdsIn.description:
Both levels are required keys; null removes that level. A level is a number (a fraction
for `pct` rules) or a formula string.
QoeThresholdsIn.title: QoeThresholdsIn

RatioCellOut.description: How one ratio value was computed: `value` = numerator ÷ denominator × `scale`.
RatioCellOut.title: RatioCellOut

RatioRowOut.description: One ratio. `values` is aligned with `periods`; `pct` values are fractions (0.05 = 5 %).
RatioRowOut.title: RatioRowOut

RowOut.description:
One line item. The arrays are aligned with the statement's `periods`; YoY and common-size
are fractions (0.05 = 5 %), not percentages. `common_size_base` is the label of the row
`common_size` divides by (revenue, total assets or the row's parent).
RowOut.title: RowOut

ScenarioIn.description: A POST: the settings not given are the default scenario's.
ScenarioIn.title: ScenarioIn

ScenarioSettingsIn.description:
A PUT: every field optional, an absent one is left as it is. An unknown field is a 422,
so a client still sending the removed horizon fields learns it at once.
ScenarioSettingsIn.title: ScenarioSettingsIn

SeasonalFactorOut.description:
`value` is the seasonal index in the line's unit; `pct` is it as a fraction of the mean
trend of the last 12 quarters (null when that mean is 0).
SeasonalFactorOut.title: SeasonalFactorOut

SeasonalityOut.description:
The components are floats over the line's latest consecutive run of quarters (statistics,
for display only).
SeasonalityOut.title: SeasonalityOut

SegmentPeriodOut.description: Like `PeriodOut`, but the dates are null for a period that has only segment values.
SegmentPeriodOut.title: SegmentPeriodOut

SegmentSeriesUpdate.description: Dimension, metric and unit are fixed once created.
SegmentSeriesUpdate.title: SegmentSeriesUpdate

TermOut.description: One input of a ratio operand; a metric lists its own inputs as `children`.
TermOut.title: TermOut

YearModeOut.description:
How a forecast year is set: `annual` or `quarterly` (by quarter). `in_span`: the year is
built from quarters and can be switched; later years are always annual.
YearModeOut.title: YearModeOut

bedrock__schemas__multiples__MultipleOut.description:
One valuation ratio. `pct` values are fractions; `percentile` is 0..1 and the range is
null with fewer than three annual values (`n`).
bedrock__schemas__multiples__MultipleOut.title: MultipleOut
